item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.2.0

  • Native macOS windows for Certificate, Connect Device and Tools — they open instantly and feel right at home. Find them in the new Certificate / Connect / Tools menus in the menu bar.
  • Connect an iOS Simulator in one click (installs the CA + sets the system proxy).
  • iOS / Android setup guides with QR codes, AirDrop and emulator support.
  • Reliability and polish across certificate install and device connect.
